messages:
maria: Heads-up — Veridian sent a security questionnaire + pen-test findings. They want a short review call (customer-facing) and concrete evidence on RBAC scoping, audit log retention/export, KMS envelope/key details, and our vuln triage timelines. Can owners chime in? cc @samir

devon: I can own RBAC + audit logging evidence. Quick Q: when they say 'separation of duties' do they want per-tenant isolation or per-service roles? We have both patterns in prod.

maria: Prefer per-tenant for Dedicated customers; for Hosted provide project-scoped roles + documented admin separation. We should produce a 1-slide matrix: role -> allowed actions -> evidence (policy + sample audit query).

alex: For KMS: we use envelope encryption with a customer-data CMK in KMS (HSM-backed). Evidence = key policy export + CloudTrail entries for GenerateDataKey/Decrypt. Example key policy snippet to include in docs:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid":"Enable IAM User Permissions","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"},
    {"Sid":"Allow use of the key","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

devon: Audit retention notes: default prod logs retained 1 year. We can export to customer S3 for longer retention (up to 7 years) on enterprise contracts. For proof, we'll include the S3 lifecycle policy and a sample CloudWatch Logs Insights query: `fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /Decrypt/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20`.

samir: Customer also asked for vuln triage process + SLA. We do initial triage within 48h, assign severity, produce mitigation plan. Will they want anonymized past tickets as examples?

maria: Yes — anonymized ticket + timeline is perfect. I will pull an example and redact customer identifiers.

sec-bot: VULN BOT: created VULN-2026-1023 and assigned to devon. Severity: HIGH. CVSS: 7.8.

devon: Received. Action plan: immediate config mitigation (disable legacy cipher), hotfix ETA 72h, full rollout across Dedicated pools 14 days. I'll add details to the vuln ticket and link to the evidence doc.

alex: Proposed RBAC changes for evidence bundle: introduce two dedicated roles `redwood:monitoring.view` and `redwood:logs.export` and bind the logging service account. Sample IAM binding snippet to show in questionnaire:
```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/logging.privateLogViewer
    members:
      - serviceAccount:redwood-logs@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

maria: @devon can you run an audit query that shows a successful Decrypt call in the last 30 days and paste a sanitized result? Customer likes recent examples.

devon: On it. Will paste query and sample results into the shared doc before EOD.

samir: Scheduling: Veridian asked for the security review call Tue 10:00 AM PT. Can we do a dry run Mon 3:00 PM PT? Maria + Devon + Alex available?

maria: Dry run Monday 3PM PT works. I'll prepare slides: RBAC matrix, KMS key policy, audit evidence screenshots, vuln triage summary.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll drop the key policy export and CloudTrail snippets into the shared folder. Also note to include the KMS 'no-export' / HSM enforcement statement and rotation cadence. Example CLI to show rotation status: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>`.

devon: Got it — I'll include the logs export path and lifecycle policies. Also will capture the CloudTrail event ids for the decryption calls.

maria: One more ask from the questionnaire: proof we cannot export raw keys. We'll include KMS key metadata + vendor HSM statement and the key policy "Allow"/"Deny" bits showing no Export action. I'll verify exact rotation cadence (likely 90d for root CMK, 30d for envelope keys) and include the key metadata.

samir: I'll send the customer's PQ template so you can fill fields directly. Thanks team — flag any blockers here so we can iterate before the dry run.
